summary: AquaBounty Technologies filed an 8-K on October 8, 2026, disclosing conversion agreements dated October 7, 2026, with holders of its Series A and Series B Convertible Preferred Stock. All outstanding preferred shares will automatically convert into common stock on the earlier of the S-3 resale registration statement's effectiveness or October 30, 2026. Conversion uses Series A liquidation value of $18.2580 and $0.9129 conversion price; Series B $20.60 and $1.03, yielding 8,077,043 shares total (5,771,929 Series A; 2,305,114 Series B). Holders waived dividends after October 15, 2026. Watch resale overhang and possible Nasdaq minimum-price pressure.
